purpose: 일의 압박이 실패 예언이 아니라 표정·손끝·한계 조절 도구에서 긴장과 회복 가능성으로 함께 읽히는 close-emotion 12개 편집 검토안이다. 2026-09-05 사용자 승인에 따라 한국어 해석·질문·제목·그림 설명의 교정본을 반영했다. 원화와 최초 제작·시각 승인 이력은 유지한다.

renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-pressure close-emotion guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair from the approved source; never add a coworker, manager, client, recipient, extra guardian, human, body clue, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or canonical pair plus one pressure-control device covers 55–65% and remains readable at actual width 80px. Frame face, hands/fins and the boundary-setting action closely so competence, tension, fatigue and relief coexist; never depict inevitable burnout, failure, punishment, flawless coping, promotion or predetermined outcome. Written work surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Every cover, plate, clip, divider, seal, marker, sleeve, gate, token, line or connector remains removable, half-set, open-ended or still adjustable. Libra may use exactly one abstract meeting balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart or heart-shaped light/void. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, deterministic route or completed coping emblem. Keep every composition distinct in close camera height, pressure source, boundary action and open negative-space shape. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
